ENGAGE MOTORS, TOP SPEED ALERT ALERT|MSE-6-G735Y to itself, alarmed by Chewbacca|audio=OfMSE-6-TopSpeedAlert.flac|}} '''MSE-6-G735Y''', or '''G7''' for short, was a [[MSE-6 series repair droid]] stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] in [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} assigned to the [[Maintenance Unit]] in [[Sector AA-345]]. It was maintained by the [[stormtrooper]] designated [[TK-421]], who considered it the fastest [[mouse]] [[droid]] in the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy|fleet]]. TK-421 wanted to be transferred to [[Coruscant]] and promised to take G7 with him to enter it into the racing circuit. G7 was attempting to carry out [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]'s order to summon TK-421 when it encountered [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo]] disguised in armor they had taken from the bodies of TK-421 and [[TK-710]], and [[Chewbacca]], who roared at the droid and sent it fleeing in self-preservation mode.. G7 was annihilated when the Death Star was destroyed by Luke Skywalker at the [[Battle of Yavin]]. {{Droid-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== MSE-6-G735Y first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]{{Film|IV}} and was first identified in the short story "[[Of MSE-6 and Men]]" by [[Glen Weldon]] in the [[2017]] anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]''.
